title: UAT plan
description: The manual UAT walk of config-digger: ordered sections of steps, which uat/runner.html shows one at a time. Keys are in English; the text is in the tester's language.

title.description: The walk's name, shown at the top of the runner.

language.description: The BCP 47 tag of the plan's text, such as "es".

id.description: The section's number, the first half of its steps' ids.
Stable: a step keeps its id when steps are added, moved or removed around it, so results and tickets keep pointing at it.

goal.description: Why the step exists: what it proves.

commands.description: Commands the tester copies, in the order the instructions use them.

expect.description: What the tester must see for the step to pass: short checks, one thing to see each. Exact UI text goes between « and ».

setup.description: A data reset to run before the step.

covers.description: The issues or spec sections the step checks, such as "#75" or "#38 story 12".

automation.description: The tools that walk the step without a tester. A step with automation and no manual is out of the tester's queue in the runner.

manual.description: What a person still checks on the step, and why no tool can. A step with manual stays in the tester's queue, whatever its automation. The WebDriver walk adds it to its notes.

tool.description: What walks the step: the fake UI's tests (fake-ui), the WebDriver walk (webdriver), the Windows Sandbox walk (sandbox), the local script (local), a CLI test (cli), a screenshot compared with its reference (visual), or the agent that judges the local walk's screenshots (agent-judge).

where.description: Where the tool runs: on CI (ci), or on a tester's or an agent's PC (local).

test.description: The check that covers the step. For webdriver and sandbox, "<file from the repo root> > <step id>": the step module in uat/auto/webdriver/steps/, or the Step block, or the verdict run.ps1 writes itself, in uat/auto/sandbox/, such as "uat/auto/webdriver/steps/notices.mjs > 5.1". For visual, a shot name of SHOTS in crates/config-digger-app/ui/scripts/screenshots.ts, such as "inventory".

text.description: The command exactly as the tester pastes it.
